title: Patient Care Desk Training: Refill Cadence Allowance on the Manufacturer Copay Card (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
A cadence allowance is added to the Manufacturer Copay Card counter benefit of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs. It follows the refills of the card's prescription dated fewer than 12 whole months before today: **10 or more** add **100.00 dollars**, **6 to 9** add **50.00 dollars**, and fewer add nothing. It is added after the counter minimum pay is taken off and before the counter benefit is held to the benefit dollars left on the program.

**Which refills count?** The refill entries of the card's prescription on the Prescriptions fill ledger dated fewer than 12 whole months before today; a refill dated exactly 12 whole months before today does not count.

**Where are the edges?**

| Refills in the window | Cadence allowance |
|---|---|
| 5 | $0.00 |
| 6 | $50.00 |
| 9 | $50.00 |
| 10 | $100.00 |

**Hypothetical:** a prescription refilled monthly with 11 refills in the window adds $100.00.
